payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design an executive dashboard. Use: large KPI cards (4-6 max), trend sparklines, high-level summary only, clean layout with white space, traffic light indicators (red/yellow/green), at-a-glance insights, minimal detail.
payload.best_for: C-suite dashboards, business summary reports, decision-maker dashboards, strategic planning views
payload.css_technical_keywords: display: flex for KPI row, large font-size (24-48px) for metrics, sparkline SVG inline, status indicators (border-left color), card shadows for hierarchy, responsive breakpoints
payload.do_not_use_for: Detailed analyst dashboards, technical deep-dives, operational monitoring
payload.effects_and_animation: KPI value animations (count-up), trend arrow direction animations, metric card hover lift, alert pulse effect
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ KPIs 4-6 maximum, ☐ Trends visible, ☐ Status colors clear, ☐ One-page view, ☐ Mobile simplified, ☐ Print-friendly layout
payload.keywords: High-level KPIs, large key metrics, minimal detail, summary view, trend indicators, at-a-glance insights, executive summary
payload.primary_colors: Brand colors, professional palette (blue/grey/white), accent for KPIs, red for alerts/concerns
payload.secondary_colors: KPI highlight colors: positive (green), negative (red), neutral (grey), trend arrow colors
